# Global Shield

> > Global Shield is an international initiative providing pre-arranged climate finance and disaster risk insurance to protect vulnerable countries from climate-related losses.

Global Shield addresses protection gaps in climate-vulnerable countries through innovative financial instruments combining microinsurance, sovereign risk transfer, and risk retention. The initiative operates through complementary governance structures including a Board, Coordination Hub, Technical Advisory Group, and Secretariat to facilitate systematic climate risk financing.

## Key Topics

- Climate and Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance (CDRFI)
- Pre-arranged finance solutions

## Implementation & Process

- [In-Country Process](https://www.globalshield.org/process): In-Country Process for identifying country-specific climate risk finance needs and options
- [Get Involved](https://www.globalshield.org/get-involved): Engagement opportunities through Global Shield Country Communities and partnerships
- [Join the Global Shield](https://www.globalshield.org/get-involved-country-communities/join-the-global-shield): Membership application and joining process for climate-vulnerable countries
- [Country Communities](https://www.globalshield.org/get-involved-country-communities/country-communities): Global Shield Country Communities for stakeholder engagement and climate adaptation

## Governance & Structure

- [Financing Structure](https://www.globalshield.org/about/financing-structure-global-shield): Global Shield Solutions Platform and Financing Facility for systematic financial protection
- [Board](https://www.globalshield.org/about/governing-bodies-global-shield-structures/board-vulnerable-countries-oversight): Global Shield Board with Co-Chair Countries representing vulnerable and supporting nations
- [Coordination Hub](https://www.globalshield.org/about/governing-bodies-global-shield-structures/coordination-hub): Coordination Hub coordinating Global Shield implementation across CDRFI implementing players
- [Technical Advisory Group](https://www.globalshield.org/about/governing-bodies-global-shield-structures/tag-independant-support-implementation): Technical Advisory Group providing independent expert support for climate risk management
- [Secretariat](https://www.globalshield.org/about/governing-bodies-global-shield-structures/secretariat): Global Shield Secretariat fostering collaboration and communication among all actors
